_note: SCRUM-37 : paraphrase en anglais de chaque template Loghub (HDFS.log_templates.csv), utilisée pour construire la requête du RAG. Elle décrit le message, sans cause supposée ni référence au label. Écrite à partir des templates seuls, sans regarder le jeu de test.
E1: DataNode adds a block replica that already exists
E2: DataNode block scanner verification of a block succeeded
E3: DataNode served a block to a client reading it
E4: DataNode got an exception while serving a block to a client
E5: DataNode starts receiving a block from a client or another DataNode
E6: DataNode received a block of a given size from a source DataNode
E7: Exception in DataNode writeBlock while receiving a block
E8: PacketResponder thread of a block was interrupted
E9: DataNode received a complete block of a given size
E10: PacketResponder thread of a block raised an exception
E11: PacketResponder thread of a block is terminating after the write
E12: Exception while writing a block to the next DataNode mirror in the write pipeline
E13: DataNode received an empty packet for a block
E14: Exception in receiveBlock while receiving a block
E15: DataNode changes the block file offset and the meta file offset of a block
E16: DataNode transmitted a block to another DataNode
E17: DataNode failed to transfer a block to another DataNode
E18: DataNode starts a thread to transfer a block to another DataNode
E20: Unexpected error while deleting a block: block info not found in the volume map
E21: DataNode deletes the file of a block
E22: NameNode allocates a new block for a file being written
E23: NameNode deletes a file and adds its block to the invalidate set of a DataNode
E24: NameNode removes a block from needed replications because it does not belong to any file
E25: NameNode asks a DataNode to replicate a block to other DataNodes
E26: NameNode updates the blockMap: a DataNode stores a replica of the block
E27: NameNode receives a redundant request to add a stored block
E28: NameNode receives a request to add a stored block that does not belong to any file
E29: Pending replication monitor timed out the replication of a block
